entities.summary: Bhagyashree Thipsay is an Indian chess player holding the title of Woman International Master (WIM). She won five times the Indian Women's Championship and the Asian Women's Championship in 1991. In 1984 she was joint winner with Vasanti Unni of the British Ladies' Championship. She competed in the Women's World Chess Championship 2000, losing in the first round to Peng Zhaoqin.
